body: Implemented: landmarks (header, nav, aside, main) are named; all form fields have labels; ticket tree uses a roving tabindex (one tab stop) with arrow keys (↑/↓, → expand / first child, ← collapse / parent, Home/End, Enter opens) and a screen-reader hint; opening a ticket from search/links moves focus to the ticket heading, opening from the tree keeps focus in the tree; a polite live region announces the opened ticket; relationship/search controls are keyboard operable with aria-expanded/listbox semantics. Verified with Playwright keyboard tests.
author: local
